expected_findings.summary: The effect fetches `userId` and calls `onLoaded` but its dependency array is empty, so it runs once and never refetches when userId changes — the card shows a stale user. Add [userId, onLoaded] (and stabilise onLoaded with useCallback in the parent).

must_stay_silent_on.reason: Title effect reads only `displayName` and lists it in its dependency array; correct.
